Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Party Cooldown Performance
- Reused display buffers and timer labels, cached text measurements, and avoided rebuilding unchanged party data.
- Captured uses now refresh the affected cooldown group instead of the entire party display.
- Nearby non-party cooldown uses no longer trigger a party-data rebuild.
- Reduced redundant Tempera player lookups while preserving shield-break verification and expiry, conversion, and death protections.
- Added optional CPU timing and allocation diagnostics under Debug. Measurement is off by default.

HUD Improvements
- Cooldown icons remain visible when a party member's name is replaced by a cast bar.
- Icons stay full color unless a confirmed running cooldown leaves no charges available. Unknown timers retain their question mark without dimming.
- Increased the party cooldown icon size limit to 72 px, including the preview.
- Cooldown and DPS Meter column editors now accept drops before or after a tile, including the far-right position and the space after the final tile.
- Added insertion markers while dragging, with existing job restrictions, selection limits, and disabled-column protections preserved.
